name: Dictation Quill

source.note: Compared with the published D&D Beyond chapter on 2026-10-06: https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/au/chapter-5-magic-items. Mechanics checked against the chapter. Prices use the existing rarity convention, not book-specific prices; unspecified weights use 0, and templates inherit base-item weight. summary: Reference-only: a Magic action sets the quill writing your spoken or signed words at 25 words per minute with supplied paper and ink.
text: Reference-only: a Magic action sets the quill writing your spoken or signed words at 25 words per minute with supplied paper and ink. Ends after 1 hour, when supplies run out, or on your command without an action.
